notes: Aucune frais de scolarité propre au programme n'est indiquée pour les étudiants non-UE : la page du programme donne seulement la taxe régionale (€140/an) et le timbre fiscal (€16), ce qui n'est pas un tuition. note.fr: Test d'admission sélectif obligatoire (CISIA English TOLC-I), à passer à distance après inscription sur le site CISIA. Un minimum de 20% du score maximal est exigé.
note.en: Compulsory selective admission test (CISIA English TOLC-I), to be taken remotely after registering on the CISIA website. A minimum threshold of 20% of the maximum score is required.

evidence.quote: Personal preparation is ascertained by means of a compulsory selective test. The compulsory selective test, required for admission to the Degree Program, is entrusted to the CISIA Consortium (English TOLC-I). Given the possible participation of non-EU students living abroad (visa applicants), the test is conducted remotely after registering on the CISIA website.
For the purposes of enrolment, the candidate must reach the minimum threshold of 20% of the maximum score for the test.

note.fr: Les candidats qui obtiennent moins de 50% à la section Mathématiques du test TOLC-I reçoivent une obligation formative additionnelle (OFA) : acquérir au moins 9 CFU en MAT/05.
note.en: Candidates who score less than 50% in the Mathematics section of the TOLC-I test receive an Additional Formative Obligation (OFA): to acquire at least 9 CFU in the MAT/05 subject area.

evidence.quote: Admitted candidates who did not score more than 50% of the marks available for the Mathematics section of the test will be assigned an Additional Formative Obligation (OFA) that requires them to acquire at least 9 University Credits (CFU) in the MAT/05 subject area before being able to sit any other examinations.

note.fr: Procédure de pré-admission obligatoire pour les étudiants non-UE nécessitant un visa : sélection de mi-février à mi-juin via la page d'admission ou par e-mail, puis lettre de pré-admission.
note.en: Compulsory pre-admission procedure for non-EU students requiring a visa: selection from mid-February to mid-June via the intake webpage or by email, then a pre-admission letter.

evidence.quote: Non-EU students who require a visa must follow a pre-admission phase, culminating in receiving a pre-admission letter (or oKer letter).

note.fr: Le candidat doit fournir une garantie financière de 6.080,00 €/an pendant trois ans et souscrire une assurance maladie/santé pour le visa d'études.
note.en: The candidate must provide a financial guarantee of €6,080.00/year for three years and take out health insurance for the study visa.
